title: Five lemma for spectral-object bottom intervals
statement: In any abelian category C, a morphism f of EInt-indexed spectral objects is an isomorphism if for all integer degrees n and all cutoffs b, its cohomology component on the interval (minus infinity,b) is invertible.

proof.text: For any a <= b, take the five consecutive interval terms H^n(bottom,a), H^n(bottom,b), H^n(a,b), H^(n+1)(bottom,a), H^(n+1)(bottom,b). The spectral-object morphism yields a commuting map between exact five-term sequences. The four outside vertical maps are invertible; apply the abelian five lemma to deduce invertibility of the middle component.

All components of every H^n natural transformation are now invertible. Assemble their natural inverses; cancellation transports connecting-arrow commutativity to these inverses. The spectral-object inverse identities hold componentwise.

lean.statement: theorem isIso_of_bottom_intervals {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] {X Y : SpectralObject C EInt} (f : X ⟶ Y) (h : ∀ (n : ℤ) (b : EInt), IsIso ((f.hom n).app (mk₁ (homOfLE (bot_le : (⊥ : EInt) ≤ b))))) : IsIso f
